title: Codex/Claude/API installer editions (Option A: variant artifacts + flag)
description: Distribution model for multi-provider gameplay binaries. Decision (this session): ship per-edition self-contained release artifacts and let the one-line installer pick one via flag/prompt. Editions: api (lean, api-native SDKs only, no agent CLI binary), claude (today's artifact: Claude Agent SDK), codex (Codex CLI binary), full (both). Mechanism: provider SDKs as optionalDependencies; per-edition npm prune/--omit when packing in release.yml. Installer (install.sh/install.ps1) gains an --edition flag (and interactive prompt). Honors one-line deploy + no manual separate install. Interacts with eshyra-5cd6 (artifact size) — Option A multiplies total release size; coordinate. Needs an ADR. Decoupled from the adapter code (eshyra-jl8n), which lazy-resolves its SDK and works under any edition.
notes: Editions (api/claude/codex/full) + prune (fixed to remove heavy platform binaries) + validator + installers + ADR 0011 + tests complete. PR #253 (feat/installer-editions-7zhm). api edition 166MB vs 403MB. api/codex runtime gated on eshyra-ern3 (lazy Claude adapter). Verified: 2130 tests pass.
close_reason: Merged in PR #253. Editions packaging deliverable complete. eshyra-ern3 (lazy Claude adapter) is a runtime follow-up that lets api/codex editions run the no-config smoke; tracked independently, not a blocker for this packaging work.
